{{Quote|Just look at that structure, a dizzying metropolis overlooking the race course. The best box seats I've ever seen!|[[Dax Gazaway]]|<ref name="Racer Revenge" />}}
'''Serres Sarrano''' was a towering city in [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], built in a dormant volcano called [[Mount Sarrano]]. The city housed millions of inhabitants and contained enormous factories dedicated to manufacturing and shipbuilding, as well as refineries and powerplants. In their downtime, most blue collar workers of Serres Sarrano sought diversion with [[Racing (disambiguation)|racing]] of any kind.<ref name="SoR" /> The [[Serres Sarrano (track)|Serres Sarrano podracing course]] was located on its outskirts.<ref name="Racer Revenge" />
